The '''''Force of Commerce''''' was the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] used by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] as his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] at the time of the abduction of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]].

==History==
Its economically-themed name followed other [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] naming practices, like that of the ''[[Tide of Progress XII/Legends|Tide of Progress XII]]'' and the [[Acquisitor (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Acquisitor'']].
